event.title: TUG rolling resistance, selected 2015-2016 results

publication.basis: Authors report measurements using their R2 Mk.2 trailer; original participant list in Table 1 and numeric road results in Table 2, DOI 10.19206/CE-2017-110.

event.surface: 11 Table 2 road surfaces, specified per metric
event.conditions: Selected Table 2 results from 2015-2016 measurements. TUG R2 Mk.2 trailer, 4000 N vertical load, regulated 210 kPa inflation, corrected to air temperature 20 C. 80 km/h except concrete block pavement explicitly 50 km/h. Two passenger-car metric sizes selected from four reported tyres. Exact SKU, product code, load/speed indices and source ranking are unreported.
